text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah---!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh...! Amazing, amazing! Biko-chan, 
you're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So this is the Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was glaring fiercely, burning 
with a roaring passion...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's so hot...! Suuuuper hot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely made his Debut,
Biko Pegasus 
proudly puffed out his chest.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I really showed off the results of 
my training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still...
everyone was even stronger than I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so tall, so it's hard to see 
what's in front of me...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even on the final straight, I thought so 
hard about where to make my move...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Can't let my guard down. If I want to 
become the strongest hero, I've got to 
train harder and harder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her running style and build really do 
work against her in sprint races after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, watching today's race convinced 
me whether she's better suited for turf
or 
dirt.
choice_data_list: Turf really seems better after all.
Turf really seems better after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Turf?! Seriously?! You think I'm suited 
for turf?
choice_data_list: Looks like turf suits you better a...
Looks like turf suits you better a...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! Yayyy!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that'll bring out your sharp...
Yeah, that way your burst of speed...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'd already decided on running the turf, 
but getting your official stamp of 
approval makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
After all,
what inspired me to race in the 
first place was Carrotman zooming 
*shubabababa!* across the blue turf...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's push forward on the turf 
races without any regrets from now on!

Yeah, but even so... we have to wa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that turf puts a heavier strain 
on the legs. I told her that for now, 
'getting used to the turf' should take 
priority over winning.

Yeah. Even so... we have to be min...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... I see... That's as precise an 
analysis as Carrotman's brains, Dr. 
Veggie...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Indeed,
impatience is a hero's 
greatest enemy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's treat this as a "training arc"
for a 
while! Carrotman has episodes like that, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Once this trial is overcome, Justice Biko 
will obtain even greater strength, 
in~deed!

Yeah, let's take our time building...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our little hero entered her 
training arc, running in all sorts of 
races for a while.
